candidates.explanation: The confirm-new-email mail builds its link to '/confirm-email', the same frontend page as the sign-up activation mail. That page calls the sign-up endpoint (POST auth/email/confirm → AuthService.confirmEmail). That endpoint requires an inactive user and doesn't apply the new email. The link should point to a dedicated page, such as '/confirm-new-email', which calls auth/email/confirm/new (AuthService.confirmNewEmail).

fix.description: In MailService.confirmNewEmail, change the URL path from '/confirm-email' to '/confirm-new-email'. The frontend page at that path must call POST /auth/email/confirm/new.
